in_sanskrit.name: Padhiyar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Scholar, Teacher
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Padhiyar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The one who teaches the scriptures and the path of righteousness. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'padh' meaning 'to learn' and 'hi' meaning 'guru' or 'teacher'.

in_hindi.name: Padhiyar
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Scholar, Teacher
in_hindi.long_meaning: Padhiyar एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The one who teaches the scriptures and the path of righteousness. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'padh' meaning 'to learn' and 'hi' meaning 'guru' or 'teacher'.

in_tamil.name: Padhiyar
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Scholar, Teacher
in_tamil.long_meaning: Padhiyar ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। The one who teaches the scriptures and the path of righteousness. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'padh' meaning 'to learn' and 'hi' meaning 'guru' or 'teacher'.

in_telugu.name: Padhiyar
in_telugu.long_meaning: Padhiyar ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। The one who teaches the scriptures and the path of righteousness. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'padh' meaning 'to learn' and 'hi' meaning 'guru' or 'teacher'.

in_marathi.name: Padhiyar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Padhiyar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who teaches the scriptures and the path of righteousness. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'padh' meaning 'to learn' and 'hi' meaning 'guru' or 'teacher'.

in_bengali.name: Padhiyar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Scholar, Teacher
in_bengali.long_meaning: Padhiyar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who teaches the scriptures and the path of righteousness. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'padh' meaning 'to learn' and 'hi' meaning 'guru' or 'teacher'.
